decisions.reason: The XL package extends the firm's existing anamnesis app with little extra cost, was announced publicly as a first-time capability, and fits the firm's dental software direction, so management will persist with it.

The support service for dental assistants has its own website page, which signals visible commitment, and it supports the core dental customer base, so any weak uptake would likely be read as a temporary start-up effect rather than a reason to drop it.
